lead: A policy is a list of path rules with capabilities. Tokens get policies; the server checks every request against them.
globHint: * matches one path segment, ** matches everything below.

matrix.title: Capabilities
matrix.empty: No rules yet. Add one, or pick a template.
matrix.hidden_one: {{count}} line with an error is not shown here, fix it in the code view.
matrix.hidden_other: {{count}} lines with errors are not shown here, fix them in the code view.

tester.title: Access tester
tester.sub: checks only this policy, in the browser
tester.noPathHint: Pick an operation to see which rule decides.
tester.noRules: This policy has no valid rules, so nothing is allowed.
tester.explicitDenyText: Rule #{{n}} denies the path, and deny overrides everything.
tester.noCapText_one: {{count}} rule matches the path, but none grants {{cap}}.
tester.noCapText_other: {{count}} rules match the path, but none grants {{cap}}.
tester.resultHere: The matching rules will appear here.

list.title: Policies
list.rootNote: The root policy is built in and cannot be edited here.

create.title: New policy
create.hint: The policy stays a draft until you save it.
create.name: Name
create.previewNone: # no rules, add them in the editor
create.errFormat: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; up to 63 characters; start with a letter or digit.

diag.capsArray: Capabilities must be an array in brackets.
diag.unknownCapSudo: Unknown capability {{cap}}. There is no sudo; use deny or write.
diag.unknownCap: Unknown capability {{cap}}. Allowed: read, write, delete, list, deny.
diag.leadingSlash: The path must not start with a slash.
diag.plusLiteral: + is a literal character here, not a wildcard.
diag.emptyCaps: The capability list is empty, so this rule grants nothing.
diag.denyOverrides: deny overrides the other capabilities in this rule.
diag.dupPath: The same path is already used on line {{line}}.
diag.singleStar: A trailing * covers one level only.

empty.title: No policies yet
empty.text: Without a policy a token can do nothing. Start from a template or create an empty one.

del.title: Delete policy
del.text: Delete the policy {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
del.checkFailed: Could not check which tokens use this policy.
del.warn403: They will lose the access this policy grants.
